ترتجعون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَجِعُونَ (tartajiʕūna) /tar.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# تُرْتَجَعُونَ (turtajaʕūna) /tur.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
